scope: Separate exploratory development validation motivated by disagreement between cached-state filters and actual sequential Train outcomes. All three full-refit policies improve actual Train total loss against the retained parent with no safety/request regression. Earlier full-refit stability filter failed for seed 44; selected-checkpoint comparison failed against the full refits for all seeds. Those failures remain failures; this run is not reported as a pass of either original protocol.
selection: Use all six already frozen checkpoints (inner selected epochs 12/13/13 and their fixed full refits). No new fitting, seed selection or epoch selection from Dev. Full refit is fixed primary mode based on original intended model and better actual generated Train losses in all seeds; selected checkpoints are a diagnostic comparison, not fallback candidates if primary Dev fails.
primaryDevCriteria: Every refit seed must worsen neither generated total nor retail expected total at missing-response rates 0, 0.1, 0.2 relative to retained parent; retain final parameter/state/type/evidence accuracy, no additional false handoffs or unnecessary/resolved-field requests, no-dropout retail necessary requests/recoveries/handoffs, and all public document metrics. At least one actual total must strictly improve for every seed. If primary fails, retain current model and do not adopt a diagnostic seed/mode after inspecting Dev.
interpretation: Dev is development evidence after multiple transparent Train studies, not confirmatory evidence of organizational effectiveness. Preserve all negative protocols, raw outcomes, terminal/request decomposition and source/sample limitations. Exact retail financial loss remains five complete Dev periods / four sources / 35 conditions. Demand calibration and public extraction are not solved by a policy-head change.
